title: Pull-Forward Share of the Next Home Comfort Financing Installment
content:
**Account terms — Home Comfort Financing, pulling the next installment forward.**

The pulled-forward share of the next installment is the account's monthly payment multiplied by the pull-forward share. The pull-forward share of the next installment is 100 percent when the most recent payment was returned and autopay is still enrolled, 50 percent when the most recent payment was returned and autopay is not enrolled, and zero when the most recent payment was not returned.

The most recent payment *was returned* when a returned-payment entry on the account is dated on or after the posting date of the most recent payment. Autopay enrollment is read from the account record.

| Most recent payment | Autopay | Pull-forward share | Share of the next installment, before any pull-forward relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| returned | still enrolled | 100 percent | the whole monthly payment |
| returned | not enrolled | 50 percent | half the monthly payment |
| not returned | any | zero | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical, monthly payment $238.47)

- An autopay draft came back and autopay remains on the account: 100 percent, $238.47 of the next installment.
- A one-time online payment came back; the account has no autopay: 50 percent, $119.235 of the next installment (unrounded; rounding happens once, on the make-up amount).
- The most recent payment stood: nothing is pulled forward.
